$description: Apollo Console override set (ADR-0011). Console INHERITS Mono's palette (Dave 2026-07-21: Console + Supercharge inherit Mono; dataviz + status/RAG identical across Mono/Console/Supercharge — only Legacy differs). The one live divergence NOW is shape: Console = rounded corners. Everything absent here falls back to Mono. Anticipated flex slots (UI greys, future input error-condition colour) are declared in _themes.json declaredSlots per ADR-0010 — a value can be added here any time without re-architecture.
